trapPreBoundaryDiagnosis.question: Does faster optional puller movement fail through body execution or an inconsistent waypoint/arrival request?
trapPreBoundaryDiagnosis.method: Saved matched trap traces only; no new native simulation. Recomputed pure force/geometry quantities from saved states.

bodyExecution.support: up; zero support xi, load, lean throughout selected free-turn interval
bodyExecution.conclusion: Recorded COM acceleration agrees with bounded existing demand; the requested abrupt turn is not instantaneously attainable. No demonstrated force/capacity defect.

firstRunnerDifference.inferenceLimit: Pre-spacing carrier request was not recorded directly. Its reconstruction uses the source contract: first designed carry tick returns press speed unless paced; only QB qualifies for radial headway, own speed<2 excludes forecast gather. Final request lies on QB headway plane to1.5e-15. Reconstructed ordinary press ray misses QB touch while intent ray intersects. Exact entry identity/native information difference was not captured.

trapPreBoundaryDiagnosis.verdict: Hold optional puller caller. Faster legal startup is demonstrated; a general two-dimensional arrival/turn contract is not. Aligning declared capture with actual handover is the smallest supported interface correction. Keep changing outgoing landmark/incoming velocity risk explicit; preserve adverse ending and censored ordinary control. No physics retune or fit-rule takeover.
trapPreBoundaryDiagnosis.remainingUncertainty: The late ending combines changed carrier choices, teammate spacing, defender/other-blocker responses and later contacts. This packet does not causally assign every0.16-yard loss to the corner. It does establish that the first divergence in runner motion is a changed command with no physical runner contact, and that the puller free-turn response is lawful.

boundary.conclusion: Mismatch is real. Matching capture reduces earlier desired speeds but alone does not prove turn feasibility because outgoing landmark changes at handover.
